policy.purpose: Partition the proportional real-Wwise evidence obligation by exact public Topic business-contract shape. A reflected or program-tested schema is not real behavioral evidence.
policy.active_live_rule: Credit requires a fresh matching event payload from the named test on the exact frozen candidate and host. Accepted publisher calls, timeouts, polls, or old evidence do not count.
policy.boundary_rule: A prerequisite or prohibited boundary receives no real PASS credit and is revisited only at its exact review trigger.
